sentences.zh: 你写过一篇报道，称总统的私人律师鲁迪·朱利安尼正计划前往乌克兰，以调查拜登父子。

sentences.en: Seems prescient.

sentences.zh: 当你问及他在乌克兰开展的这项工作时，朱利安尼对你说了这样一段话。

sentences.en: He says,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: And I'm going to give them reasons why they shouldn't stop because that information will be very, very helpful to my client and may turn out to be helpful to my government.
sentences.zh: 我要给他们理由，告诉他们为什么不该停下，因为这些信息对我的客户将非常非常有用，也许对我的政府也会有所帮助。

sentences.en: And then you write,
sentences.zh: 然后你写道，

sentences.zh: 朱利安尼先生的介入引发了人们的质疑：特朗普先生是否在纵容一种努力，

sentences.en: a foreign government to proceed with a case that could hurt a political opponent at home.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: So you had that story all the way back in May.

sentences.zh: 那为什么直到现在，这些内幕才引发弹劾调查呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a good question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: I mean, I think we understood a lot of the puzzle back then.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为我们当时就已经理清了许多谜团。

sentences.en: But what we didn't understand was the degree to which the president himself was personally involved in
sentences.zh: 但我们当时并不了解的是，总统本人在多大程度上亲自参与了

sentences.en: pushing the Ukrainians to investigate and provide dirt on the president's political rivals.
sentences.zh: 向乌克兰施压，要求他们调查并提供总统政治对手的黑料。

sentences.en: Some of that stuff had yet to happen when we first addressed this.
sentences.zh: 当我们首次探讨此事时，其中一些事情甚至还没有发生。

sentences.en: And then only more recently have we learned about the vivid details of his involvement, and those have been really eyebrow-raising.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，我们才了解到他参与其中的生动细节，而这些细节实在令人瞠目结舌。

sentences.zh: 好吧，你得回过头来看看鲁迪·朱利安尼。

sentences.en: He, of course, was the mayor of New York City, including during the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks.
sentences.zh: 他当然曾担任纽约市长，包括在2001年9月11日恐怖袭击发生期间。

sentences.en: I'm here on behalf of a very grateful and very admiring city and saying how proud we are of the innocent

sentences.en: And his leadership during that horrible time earned him the reputation of America's mayor.
sentences.zh: 他在那个可怕时期的领导力，为他赢得了“美国市长”的美誉。

sentences.zh: 对于每一个被这场不可想象的悲剧触动的人来说，一直有这样一个人，超越所有人，成为了将这座城市凝聚在一起并引领它向前迈进的明灯。

sentences.en: And when he leaves office at the end of 2001, he's got this great reputation, and he's really riding high.

sentences.en: He's the mayor who helped New York recover from 9-11.
sentences.zh: 他是帮助纽约从“9·11”中恢复过来的市长。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that made him a really marketable commodity as a consultant, consulting on security issues.
sentences.zh: 这使他作为一名顾问、安全问题咨询师，在市场上极具商业价值。

sentences.en: But he always kind of craved the political fight.

sentences.en: And then people started voting.
sentences.zh: 然后人们开始投票了。

sentences.zh: 于是他回归商业，并在乌克兰开展了大量业务。

sentences.en: And Ken, why Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 肯，为什么是乌克兰？

sentences.en: Ukraine is a place that has drawn a lot of Western consultants and politicians and big names.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰是一个吸引了大量西方顾问、政客和知名人士的地方。

sentences.en: It's a place where there's a lot of money to be made from a handful of oligarchs and wealthy interests
sentences.zh: 在那里，少数寡头和富裕利益集团可以带来巨额财富，

sentences.en: that are looking for legitimacy that they believe that they can get from prominent Americans.
sentences.zh: 他们正在寻求他们认为可以从杰出美国人那里获得的合法性。

sentences.en: And there was no more prominent American than Rudy Giuliani at that time period.
sentences.zh: 而在那个时期，没有什么美国人比鲁迪·朱利安尼更显赫了。

sentences.en: And what are Ukraine's security needs when it comes to someone like Rudy Giuliani?
sentences.zh: 说到像鲁迪·朱利安尼这样的人，乌克兰有哪些安全需求？

sentences.en: Ukraine has a lot of needs in this space.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰在这一领域有许多需求。

sentences.en: The most pressing concern for Ukraine is its neighbor looming to the east, Russia.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰最紧迫的担忧是其东部虎视眈眈的邻国——俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Overnight, dozens of armed pro-Russian forces seized control of the international airport and military airport in Ukraine's Crimea region.
sentences.zh: 一夜之间，数十名武装亲俄力量夺取了乌克兰克里米亚地区的国际机场和军用机场的控制权。

sentences.en: A day after, pro-Russian gunmen took over government buildings in the city and raised the Russian flag.
sentences.zh: 一天后，亲俄枪手接管了该市的政府大楼并升起了俄罗斯国旗。

sentences.en: And so what Ukrainians are looking for and what Rudy Giuliani has in spades is both a reputation for being tough on crime, tough on terrorism,
sentences.zh: 因此，乌克兰人所寻找的、而鲁迪·朱利安尼又恰好拥有的，既是打击犯罪、打击恐怖主义的强硬声誉，

sentences.en: and also being able to represent sort of a de facto endorsement from the United States of America, which is something that is coveted and so important in Ukraine
sentences.zh: 也是能够代表美利坚合众国的某种事实上的背书，这在乌克兰是梦寐以求且至关重要的，

sentences.en: to have support from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 即获得来自美国的支援，

sentences.en: in their effort to stave off Russian aggression.
sentences.zh: 以协助他们抵御俄罗斯的侵略。

sentences.zh: ——在这段时期，朱利安尼与唐纳德·特朗普的关系如何？

sentences.en: — So the relationship goes back more than two decades to when Trump was actively developing real estate in New York, and Giuliani was the mayor, of course.
sentences.zh: ——两人的关系可以追溯到二十多年前，当时特朗普正在纽约积极开发房地产，而朱利安尼当时正是市长。

sentences.en: And then they kind of overlapped in social circles and a little bit in political circles.
sentences.zh: 后来他们的社交圈子有所重叠，在政治圈里也有过一些交集。

sentences.en: And then their relationship takes a new turn in 2016, when a lot of the more establishment Republicans are sort of keeping their distance from Trump,
sentences.zh: 接着，他们的关系在2016年迎来了新的转折，当时许多建制派共和党人都在与特朗普保持距离，

sentences.en: who is still seen as kind of a toxic figure, even as he's closing in on the Republican nomination,
sentences.zh: 尽管特朗普即将获得共和党提名，但他当时仍被视为一个具有毒性的政治人物，

sentences.zh: 而朱利安尼却依然决定为他背书。

sentences.en: — That's what I don't understand.
sentences.zh: ——这就是我不明白的地方。

sentences.zh: 你为什么不说：“我是鲁迪·朱利安尼。”

sentences.zh: “我在纽约政坛很有分量。”

sentences.en: — Okay, I'm Rudy Giuliani.
sentences.zh: ——好吧，“我是鲁迪·朱利安尼。”

sentences.zh: ——“我支持唐纳德·特朗普。”

sentences.zh: ——好吧，“我是鲁迪·朱利安尼。”

sentences.en: — Well, I don't understand.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，我不明白。

sentences.en: What does that last point—
sentences.zh: 最后这句话到底是什么意思——

sentences.en: — It's kind of a lukewarm endorsement at first, but he's really one of the early establishment Republicans to get behind Trump.
sentences.zh: ——起初这算是一种不冷不热的背书，但他确实是早期支持特朗普的建制派共和党人之一。

sentences.en: And it pays off.
sentences.zh: 这得到了回报。

sentences.en: When Trump is elected, Giuliani is seen as a power broker.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普当选时，朱利安尼被视为政治掮客。

sentences.en: And for a time, his name was even bandied about as a potential nominee for secretary of state.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他的名字甚至被当作国务卿的潜在人选广为流传。

sentences.en: Now, ironically, one of the reasons why he was passed over for some of these positions was that his foreign consulting work was seen as something of a liability.
sentences.zh: 然而具有讽刺意味的是，他被排除在这些职位之外的原因之一，正是他的海外咨询工作被视为一种负累。

sentences.en: And so that was seen as something of a letdown.
sentences.zh: 所以这被认为是一次打击。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, he stayed an important figure in Trump's world.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他依然是特朗普核心圈子里举足轻重的人物。

sentences.en: And when the Mueller investigation started,
sentences.zh: 随着穆勒调查的展开，

sentences.en: Rudy was eventually tapped as one of President Trump's lead defense attorneys in that.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪最终被任命为特朗普总统在该案中的首席辩护律师之一。

sentences.en: — There's no reason for this investigation.
sentences.zh: ——这场调查毫无理由。

sentences.en: There never was a good reason for it in the first place.
sentences.zh: 从一开始就没有任何充分的理由。

sentences.en: This is just plain wrong.
sentences.zh: 这简直是大错特错。

sentences.en: — And is Giuliani still doing business with these overseas security clients while he's representing the president as a lawyer?
sentences.zh: ——那么，朱利安尼在作为总统律师代表总统的同时，是否还在与这些海外安全客户做生意？

sentences.en: — Yes.
sentences.zh: ——是的。

sentences.en: And in fact, not only is he juggling both roles, but it's arguable that his role as the president's attorney makes him more marketable
sentences.zh: 事实上，他不仅兼顾这两个角色，而且可以说，他作为总统律师的身份使他在市场上更具吸引力，

sentences.en: and more coveted as a consultant by some of these foreign interests who see having someone who is close to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 也更受某些外国利益集团的追捧，因为这些利益集团认为，雇佣一个与美国

sentences.en: president on their payroll as something that could be of enormous benefit.
sentences.zh: 总统关系密切的人能带来巨大的利益。

sentences.en: — And how does Giuliani navigate that?
sentences.zh: ——朱利安尼是如何处理这种状况的？

sentences.en: As you say, it's kind of fraught, but it's also an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，这既充满风险，但也蕴含着机遇。

sentences.en: — Well, he does it in an interesting way, which is that he continues traveling the world, meeting with prospective clients, even as he is representing the president.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，他处理的方式很有趣，那就是在代表总统的同时，他继续周游世界，会见潜在客户。

sentences.en: And there are cases, including in Ukraine, where these two roles do seem to intersect.
sentences.zh: 在包括乌克兰在内的某些案例中，这两个角色似乎确实产生了交集。

sentences.en: — How so?
sentences.zh: ——怎么说？

sentences.en: — Well, you have to back up and look at Trump's obsession with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: ——好吧，你必须回过头来看看特朗普对乌克兰的执念。

sentences.en: — Plus, the Democrats colluded on the Ukraine, so they colluded.
sentences.zh: ——而且，民主党人在乌克兰问题上串通一气，他们串通了。

sentences.en: — Trump has had these theories going back to 2016 that it was actually the Ukrainians who meddled in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: ——特朗普从2016年起就一直持有这样一种理论：实际上是乌克兰人干预了2016年大选。

sentences.en: — Not Russia.
sentences.zh: ——而不是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: And they meddled in it to help Hillary Clinton and to hurt him.
sentences.zh: 他们干预大选是为了帮助希拉里·克林顿并伤害他。

sentences.en: And it turns out Rudy Giuliani was hearing some of the same stuff.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，鲁迪·朱利安尼也听到了类似的说法。

sentences.en: — I got information about three or four months ago that a lot of the explanation for how this whole phony investigation started will be in the Ukraine,
sentences.zh: ——我在三四个月前得到消息称，关于这场虚假调查是如何开始的，许多解释都将指向乌克兰，

sentences.en: that there were a group of people in the Ukraine that were working to help Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰有一群人一直在协助希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: — And so he became the perfect person to investigate these theories and use them and develop them to try to undermine the Mueller investigation.

sentences.en: — And you know what's going to happen in the next two to three months?
sentences.zh: ——你知道未来两到三个月会发生什么吗？

sentences.en: We're going to find out that there is a crime that was committed.
sentences.zh: 我们会发现确实发生了一桩犯罪行为。

sentences.en: — And it's called conspiracy with Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: ——这就叫与乌克兰人勾结。

sentences.zh: 这完全、彻底是一场反情报骗局。

sentences.en: — And Ken, is there any validity to the Trump theory that has been picked up by Giuliani that Ukraine was trying to hurt Trump in 2016 and trying to assist the Democrats?
sentences.zh: ——肯，特朗普的这种理论（已被朱利安尼采纳）是否有任何依据，即乌克兰在2016年试图伤害特朗普并协助民主党？

sentences.en: — So there's not really a simple answer to that question, Michael.
sentences.zh: ——迈克尔，这个问题其实没有简单的答案。

sentences.en: There are certainly people in Ukraine who believe that there were Ukrainian officials who were too supportive of Hillary Clinton
sentences.zh: 乌克兰确实有人认为，某些乌克兰官员过于支持希拉里·克林顿，

sentences.en: and that some of those officials may have acted improperly in releasing this information about Paul Manafort that forced his resignation from the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: 并且其中一些官员在泄露有关保罗·马纳福特的讯息时可能行为不当，这最终迫使他辞去了特朗普竞选团队的职务。

sentences.en: Now, that said, there are also some theories that Trump and Giuliani have floated that are completely bogus and have been definitively debunked.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，特朗普和朱利安尼散布的一些理论也完全是无稽之谈，并且已经被彻底戳穿。

sentences.en: And those include the idea that it was Ukraine and not Russia that actually did the hacking of the Democratic National Committee and that Ukraine then sought to frame Russia
sentences.zh: 其中包括这样一种观点：对民主党全国委员会进行黑客攻击的实际上是乌克兰而不是俄罗斯，随后乌克兰企图嫁祸俄罗斯，

sentences.en: and make it appear as if Russia was working with the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: 让外界误以为俄罗斯在与特朗普竞选团队合作。

sentences.en: We know from the Mueller investigation that all of that is completely wrong.
sentences.zh: 我们从穆勒调查中得知，所有这些都是彻头彻尾的错误。

sentences.en: — So what happens with this Giuliani investigation in Ukraine that's been blessed by the president?
sentences.zh: ——那么，得到总统祝福的朱利安尼乌克兰调查后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: — So Giuliani is reaching out to people in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: ——朱利安尼一直在与乌克兰方面的人士接触。

sentences.en: He has associates who are over there.
sentences.zh: 他的同伙当时正在那边。

sentences.en: He's exploring some of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 他正在深入挖掘其中的一些情况。

sentences.en: And he says that in the process of poking around, he comes across this other theory that might be equally beneficial to President Trump, and that involves the Bidens
sentences.zh: 而且他说，在四处打听的过程中，他偶然发现了另一套理论，这套理论可能对特朗普总统同样有利，其中涉及拜登

sentences.en: and their activity in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 以及他们在乌克兰的活动。

sentences.en: — Joe Biden was appointed the point man for Ukraine.
sentences.zh: ——乔·拜登被任命为乌克兰事务的牵头人。

sentences.en: Two to three weeks later, his son Hunter was appointed to a position on the most corrupt agency or the most corrupt business in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 两到三周后，他的儿子亨特被任命为乌克兰最腐败机构或最腐败企业中的一个职位。

sentences.en: — The theory is that Joe Biden, as vice president, in his capacity as the Obama administration's point person on Ukraine, pushed the Ukrainian government to get rid of a prosecutor
sentences.zh: ——这种理论认为，乔·拜登作为副总统，以奥巴马政府乌克兰事务牵头人的身份，曾施压乌克兰政府撤换一名检察官

sentences.en: who was widely regarded as corrupt, not because this prosecutor was corrupt and it was in the interest of the United States to help Ukraine root out corruption,
sentences.zh: 该检察官被普遍认为腐败，促使其被撤换不是因为他腐败、且帮助乌克兰根除腐败符合美国的利益，

sentences.en: but rather because this prosecutor represented a threat to an oligarch who owned a gas company that was paying Joe Biden's son Hunter Biden as a board member.
sentences.zh: 而是因为这名检察官对某位寡头构成了威胁，该寡头拥有一家天然气公司，而该公司一直在向乔·拜登的儿子亨特·拜登支付董事薪酬。

sentences.en: — But is there anything to this Biden theory that Giuliani is cultivating?
sentences.zh: ——但朱利安尼正在培育的这套“拜登理论”有什么实质内容吗？

sentences.en: — There is no evidence that Joe Biden pushed the Ukrainian government to fire this prosecutor because it would help his son or the company that was paying him as a board member.
sentences.zh: ——没有证据表明，乔·拜登是因为这会有助于他的儿子或向其支付董事薪酬的公司，才施压乌克兰政府解雇这名检察官的。

sentences.en: Now, that said, with everything in Ukraine, it's not quite that simple.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，结合乌克兰的一切情况来看，事情并没有那么简单。

sentences.en: In fact, the people around that company were relieved when that prosecutor was fired and that's because they thought he was holding open the possibility of investigations
sentences.zh: 事实上，那家公司周围的人在这名检察官被解雇时松了一口气，那是因为他们认为他保留了对该公司和这位寡头进行调查的可能性

sentences.en: of this company and the oligarch in order to be able to solicit a bribe to get him to stand down, which is, unfortunately, kind of the way that the Ukrainian
sentences.zh: 以此来勒索贿赂，迫使他让步，而不幸的是，这在某种程度上正是乌克兰

sentences.en: prosecutorial and judicial system work.
sentences.zh: 检察和司法系统的运作方式。

sentences.en: — So what does Giuliani do next to try to actually prove these grand theories based on what feel like these teeny-tiny crumbs of fact and suspicion?
sentences.zh: ——那么，朱利安尼接下来会做什么，来试图真正证明这些宏大理论呢？这些理论感觉只是基于极其微小的真相和猜疑碎片。

sentences.en: — So Rudy is working, including with Ukrainians, to try to gain traction on some of this stuff.
sentences.zh: ——所以鲁迪正在采取行动，包括与乌克兰人合作，试图在其中一些事情上取得进展。

sentences.en: He's working with associates of his, and they are gathering records.
sentences.zh: 他正与自己的同伙合作，收集记录。

sentences.en: They get him on the phone with some prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 他们安排他与一些检察官通电话。

sentences.en: And then finally, in January of this year,
sentences.zh: 最后，在今年一月，

sentences.en: Rudy gets a meeting in New York with the top Ukrainian prosecutor, a guy by the name of Yuri Lutsenko.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪在纽约与乌克兰顶级检察官、一个名叫尤里·卢岑科的家伙举行了会面。

sentences.en: — And we understand that this meeting transpired over the course of a day or two with multiple sessions, many hours long.
sentences.zh: ——据我们了解，这次会面持续了一两天，进行了多场会议，长达数小时。

sentences.en: And Rudy is so enthusiastic about the information that Lutsenko is providing to him that at one point,
sentences.zh: 鲁迪对卢岑科向他提供的信息非常热情，以至于在某个时刻，

sentences.en: Rudy actually picks up the phone and calls Trump and starts to brief him on what he's hearing.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪竟然拿起电话打给特朗普，开始向他简要汇报自己听到的情况。

sentences.en: — Why?
sentences.zh: ——为什么？

sentences.en: What is so exciting?
sentences.zh: 有什么好兴奋的？

sentences.en: — Well, Rudy thinks he's found a powerful Ukrainian partner to pursue these matters.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，鲁迪认为他找到了一个强大的乌克兰伙伴来跟进这些事情。

sentences.en: And when I say pursue the matters, I don't just mean to provide him dirt.
sentences.zh: 当我说道推进这些事情时，我不仅仅是指向他提供黑料。

sentences.en: I mean actually moving forward with investigations in Ukraine into some of these matters.
sentences.zh: 我是指在乌克兰实际推进对其中一些事情的调查。

sentences.en: And that's quite notable because in 2017, this same prosecutor,
sentences.zh: 这非常引人注目，因为在2017年，这位同名检察官，

sentences.en: Yuri Lutsenko, had actually closed investigations into the oligarch who owned the gas company that employed Hunter Biden and to the company itself.
sentences.zh: 尤里·卢岑科，实际上已经结案了对这家天然气公司（该公司雇用了亨特·拜登）的寡头以及公司本身的调查。

sentences.en: And so it's quite a notable turnabout that this prosecutor is now willing to pursue these investigations that could be of huge benefit to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个检察官现在愿意推进这些可能对特朗普总统有巨大好处的调查，这是一个非常显著的转变。

sentences.en: — Well, help me understand why a Ukrainian prosecutor would ever want to do this kind of favor for Giuliani and for President Trump.
sentences.zh: ——好吧，请帮我理解为什么乌克兰检察官会愿意为朱利安尼和特朗普总统做这种人情。

sentences.en: — Well, there are a couple of theories on that.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，对此有几种理论。

sentences.en: Both of them have at their heart
sentences.zh: 它们的核心都是

sentences.en: Ukrainian politics that were unfolding at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时正在演变的乌克兰政治。

sentences.en: The president was running for re-election.
sentences.zh: 总统正在竞选连任。

sentences.en: This is the president who appointed Lutsenko, was seen as a patron of Lutsenko, and he was not doing very well.
sentences.zh: 这就是任命了卢岑科、被视为卢岑科保护伞的这位总统，而他的民调表现并不好。

sentences.en: And so some of his allies thought that if he were able to throw President Trump a bone, give President Trump something that he wanted,
sentences.zh: 因此，他的一些盟友认为，如果他能向特朗普总统示好，给特朗普总统想要的东西，

sentences.en: President Trump might reciprocate and signal some support for the Ukrainian president.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统可能会回报并对乌克兰总统表达一些支持。

sentences.en: But secondarily, if the president ended up losing,
sentences.zh: 但其次，如果总统最终落选，

sentences.en: Lutsenko was looking for some powerful allies in the United States who might be willing to go to bat for him with the new president and say, hey, this guy, this prosecutor,
sentences.zh: 卢岑科正在寻找美国的一些强大盟友，他们可能愿意在新总统面前为他说好话，说，嘿，这家伙，这个检察官，

sentences.en: Lutsenko, is good.
sentences.zh: 卢岑科，人很好。

sentences.en: You should keep him.
sentences.zh: 你们应该留用他。

sentences.en: And so there is some thinking that that was motivating
sentences.zh: 因此，有人认为正是这种想法在激励着

sentences.en: Lutsenko to get into bed with Rudy.
sentences.zh: 卢岑科与鲁迪勾结在一起。

sentences.en: — So the understanding after Giuliani meets with Lutsenko is that Lutsenko would be pushing the investigations inside Ukraine that President Trump wants and that President Trump
sentences.zh: ——因此，朱利安尼与卢岑科会面后的共识是，卢岑科将在乌克兰内部推动特朗普总统想要的调查，而特朗普总统

sentences.en: would help Lutsenko's boss get re-elected president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 将帮助卢岑科的老板重新当选乌克兰总统。

sentences.en: So there would be, you know, something in it for everybody.
sentences.zh: 所以你知道的，这对每个人都有好处。

sentences.en: — That's right.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: — So what ends up actually happening?
sentences.zh: ——那最终实际发生了什么？

sentences.en: — Well, Lutsenko goes back to Ukraine and, in fact, he does take some steps towards pushing forward these investigations and issues what is known in Ukraine
sentences.zh: ——嗯，卢岑科回到了乌克兰，事实上，他确实采取了一些措施来推动这些调查，并在乌克兰发布了所谓的

sentences.en: as a notice of suspicion to the oligarch who owned the gas company on his board
sentences.zh: 嫌疑告知书，针对的是其董事会曾有亨特·拜登任职的天然气公司的寡头，

sentences.en: Hunter Biden sat and it was enough to make Rudy feel pretty good about what was going on.
sentences.zh: 这足以让鲁迪对进展感到相当不错。

sentences.en: — And what about the other side of the understanding that Trump would help
sentences.zh: ——那么特朗普将帮助

sentences.en: Lutsenko's boss?
sentences.zh: 卢岑科老板的另一半共识呢？

sentences.en: — Yeah, that didn't really pan out so much as some of the allies of the president had hoped they never really got the full-throated support of President Trump that they thought
sentences.zh: ——是的，事情并没有像总统的一些盟友所希望的那样顺利发展，他们从未真正获得特朗普总统的全力支持，他们原本以为

sentences.en: that they might get if they gave Trump and Rudy Giuliani what they were seeking in terms of pushing forward these matters that Trump and Giuliani want to investigate it
sentences.zh: 只要把特朗普和鲁迪·朱利安尼想要调查的这些事情推进下去，并把他们寻找的东西交给特朗普和鲁迪·朱利安尼，他们就能得到这种支持，

sentences.en: and Lutsenko's boss, the president, goes down to defeat in a landslide.
sentences.zh: 而卢岑科的老板，即总统，在选举中惨败。

sentences.en: — What does that election result mean for Trump and for Giuliani?
sentences.zh: ——选举结果对特朗普和朱利安尼意味着什么？

sentences.en: — Well, it's bad news for them because they had developed this relationship with this prosecutor who was going to pursue the matters that they wanted to see pursued and suddenly
sentences.zh: ——嗯，这对他们来说是个坏消息，因为他们已经与这位检察官发展了这种关系，而这位检察官本来要追踪他们希望追踪的事情，但突然之间

sentences.en: this prosecutor's job is in jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 这位检察官的工作岌岌可危。

sentences.en: In fact, on election night, the president-elect signals that he wants to get rid of Lutsenko.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在选举之夜，当选总统就示意他想除掉卢岑科。

sentences.en: So Giuliani and Trump are left scratching their heads trying to figure out is there a way for them to continue this effort and they ultimately end up taking a series of steps
sentences.zh: 因此，朱利安尼和特朗普只能一头雾水地绞尽脑汁，试图弄清楚是否有办法继续这项努力，他们最终采取了一系列步骤，

sentences.en: that lead us to where we are today.
sentences.zh: 这把我们带到了今天的地步。

sentences.en: — Which is an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: ——也就是弹劾调查。

sentences.en: — Yeah.
sentences.zh: ——是的。

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: ——我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: ——《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能获取所有报道。

sentences.en: — Ken, what do Giuliani and Trump do in the face of this pretty big setback in their efforts to get Ukraine to conduct these investigations that they want?
sentences.zh: ——肯，面对让他们乌克兰进行这些他们想要的调查的努力遭受的相当大挫折，朱利安尼和特朗普做了什么？

sentences.en: — Well, they start trying to make it pretty clear to the new president
sentences.zh: ——嗯，他们开始向新总统

sentences.en: Zelensky and to the people around him that this is something that they feel pretty strongly about and want to see continue.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基及其身边的人明确表示，这是他们非常坚决、希望看到继续推进的事情。

sentences.en: And this starts, our reporting suggests, on election night.
sentences.zh: 据我们的报道显示，这从选举之夜就开始了。

sentences.en: — We did it.
sentences.zh: ——我们成功了。

sentences.en: Together.
sentences.zh: 齐心协力。

sentences.en: — On the night that Zelensky is triumphant in this huge landslide, he gets a call from President Trump.
sentences.zh: ——在泽连斯基在这次压倒性大胜中获胜的当晚，他接到了特朗普总统的电话。

sentences.en: It's the typical congratulatory call.
sentences.zh: 这是一通例行的祝贺电话。

sentences.en: But then, at the end of the call,
sentences.zh: 但在电话快结束时，

sentences.en: Trump expresses his commitment to work together with President
sentences.zh: 特朗普表达了他致力于与总统

sentences.en: Alex Zelensky and the Ukrainian people to implement reforms that strengthen democracy, increase prosperity, and root out corruption.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基以及乌克兰人民共同努力，实施增强民主、促进繁荣和根除腐败的改革。

sentences.en: And that's a direct quote, by the way, from the White House readout of the call.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这是白宫关于该通话记录的直接引语。

sentences.en: — And what do you make of that last line?
sentences.zh: ——你对最后一句话有什么看法？

sentences.en: — Yeah, why that is significant is because for people who have been following this on both sides of the Atlantic, they know that when the Trump folks say corruption,
sentences.zh: ——是的，之所以意义重大，是因为对于大西洋两岸一直关注此事的人来说，他们知道当特朗普的人说腐败时，

sentences.en: what they really mean is that they want an investigation of the Bidens and the Hunter Bidens work for this gas company and also this idea that Ukrainians acted improperly to meddle
sentences.zh: 他们真正想说的是，他们希望对拜登以及亨特·拜登为这家天然气公司的工作进行调查，还有这种观点，即乌克兰人曾为希拉里·克林顿的利益不当干预

sentences.en: in the 2016 election on behalf of Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 2016年大选中。

sentences.en: So, even just that word, corruption, it is now widely understood when raised by the Trump folks to mean we want these investigations.
sentences.zh: 因此，甚至连“腐败”这个词，现在在被特朗普团队提及时代表的意思也是广为人知的，即我们想要这些调查。

sentences.en: — And do you think
sentences.zh: ——你认为

sentences.en: Zelensky would have understood that to mean what you just described?
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基会明白那意味着你刚才所描述的意思吗？

sentences.en: — I think he would because his people had been following this and they were in communication with Americans who were telling them that that's what this means.
sentences.zh: ——我认为他会，因为他的人民一直在关注此事，并且他们一直在与美国人交流，美国人告诉他们这就是这个词的意思。

sentences.en: — And what's your sense of what this new
sentences.zh: ——你觉得这位新任

sentences.en: Ukrainian president,
sentences.zh: 乌克兰总统

sentences.en: Zelensky, is making of Trump and how open he is to helping the president?
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基对特朗普有何看法，他多大程度上愿意帮助总统？

sentences.en: — I think that once it becomes clear what Trump wants, it becomes clear to the people around Zelensky that he's in a horrible position, really a no-win position.
sentences.zh: ——我认为，一旦特朗普想要什么变得清晰，泽连斯基身边的人就会清楚他处境糟糕，确实是一个左右为难的困境。

sentences.en: He knows that he needs to keep in the good graces of the United States president because Ukraine is so dependent on assistance, both military assistance and other forms
sentences.zh: 他知道自己需要保持美国总统的青睐，因为乌克兰非常依赖美国的援助，包括军事援助和其他形式

sentences.en: of assistance and support from the United States.
sentences.zh: 的援助与支持。

sentences.zh: 如果他拒绝并回绝

sentences.zh: 特朗普总统和鲁迪·朱利安尼在这些调查上的要求，他知道这将冒着疏远美国总统并可能破坏这种关系的风险。

sentences.en: president and potentially undermining that relationship.
